testcase.name: actions that touch no data say so()
an invalid sourceRef is reported by code, not by a parse exception()
a sourceRef in the document wins over a slot binding()
a mapping is resolved with the operation key of its own query()
REFRESH_QUERY resolves a read query and record actions resolve a write query()
a data source with a sourceRef resolves to that registration()
a runtime id used where a local id belongs is never resolved and never accepted()
a query resolves to its source and approved operation, never to a stored runtime id()
a query without an operation key cannot be resolved()
an action of the wrong query mode fails with WRONG_MODE()
CALL_API resolves an approved operation of a registered source, not a URL()
a binding that reaches no query or a write query fails with a stable code()
missing references are reported with UNKNOWN_REFERENCE or NO_QUERY()
a data binding reads through its view model, query and mapping()
an unbound slot resolves through the runtime slot bindings and fails without them()
a mapping is translated from the local query id to the operation key C3 knows()
resolving never changes the definition and no runtime id appears in it()
every record action resolves its write query()
